idea-plugin.name: Registry Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Go to Declaration on a component registry slot jumps to the components, not the getter.

Where a consumer writes FooRegistry.Bar and a class hierarchy decides which implementation that becomes, Ctrl+B normally lands on the base getter and stops. This adds every overriding implementation's component as a target.

Requires the JavaScript plugin (WebStorm, or IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate).
